business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bulk Dehydrated Garlic Flakes and Crushed Chili Pepper Export

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law jurisdictional foundation with statutory codification in the Business Corporations Act and Associations Law; influenced by U.S. Delaware corporate jurisprudence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty with the United States
Not a party to the OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters in force for corporate tax purposes
Tax Information Exchange Agreements with the United States and certain EU member states
Member of the Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) trade framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (as amended), Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2018 (AML/CFT Act); Companies (Non-Resident) Regulations; Registrar of Corporations (UBO) Directive No. 2021-03; Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Recommendations as applied through the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) membership

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Name Reservation confirmation leading to incorporation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Office of the Attorney General
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not required for internal registry record; apostille only if the certificate is to be used abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft, signed by incorporator)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant / licensed incorporation agent in the Marshall Islands or a recognized foreign law firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of signing, followed by the Hague Apostille if the signatory jurisdiction is an Apostille member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency (draft post-incorporation, initially required for bank/LC openers)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization if the issuing agent is in a non-Apostille jurisdiction; otherwise Hague Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Director/Shareholder Government-Issued ID and Proof of Residential Address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office or public notary in the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, per the recipient bank's policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Corporate Charter and Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Apostille states)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation watchlists, Interpol Red Notices (negative media), HM Treasury Consolidated List, and Marshall Islands domestic sanctions directives. Enhanced due diligence is automatically triggered for PEP status, politically exposed family members, or close associates. For this low-risk dehydrated spices trading scope, standard CDD is applied after passing PEP/sanctions screening, with ongoing transaction monitoring under the AML/CFT Act and the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit guidance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations online name availability service (through the official website of the Republic of the Marshall Islands Office of the Attorney General, Registrar of Corporations division; licensed registered agents have direct portal access)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official corporate language. Names must be in Roman script using the English alphabet. Arabic numerals, standard punctuation (hyphen, comma, period, ampersand) are permitted at the registrar's discretion. No non-Roman script, diacritics, or symbols are accepted. Any foreign-language trade name must be transliterated into English and may be reserved as a secondary name; the English name is the sole legal corporate name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 21 calendar days of rejection. The appeal must include (i) the rejected name, (ii) the registrar's reference number, (iii) a legal argument distinguishing the name from prohibited tokens or confusingly similar names, and (iv) any supporting trademark or goodwill evidence. The Registrar must decide within 15 business days. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may file a further administrative review with the Minister of Justice or seek judicial review in the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days. During the appeal, no new name reservation is accepted for the same entity; after final rejection, the applicant may file a fresh name reservation with a revised name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a non-resident Business Corporation only through a licensed registered agent maintaining a physical office in the Marshall Islands. The registered agent serves as the statutory office for service of process and official correspondence. A purely virtual office without a Marshall Islands licensed registered agent is not acceptable. For this industry (bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper export), no physical premises, warehouse, or local staff are required in the Marshall Islands; the corporate substance is effectively met by maintaining the registered agent address, statutory records, and a governing body meeting that can be held by teleconference or written consent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated 2% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection. The Registry and the Marshall Islands FIU may conduct targeted inspections for AML/CFT compliance or abuse indicators (e.g., shell-like transaction patterns, repetitive high-risk counterparty jurisdictions). No industry-specific inspection regime applies to ISIC 4638. Given a low-risk standard commercial tier, the likelihood of an on-site visit is materially lower than 5% in the first operating year.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (as amended), modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law — Section 10 (Certificate of Incorporation), Section 14 (Registered Agent), Section 15 (Registered Office), Sections 31–32 (Bylaws), and Section 53 (Officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation executed by the Incorporator and filed under Section 10 of the Business Corporations Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Business Corporation may be formed with a single no-par share and unprescribed capital, and no escrow or depositary account is mandated for a non-resident domestic corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the Certificate of Incorporation filed with the Registrar of Corporations and the Bylaws submitted to this First Board Meeting are approved and ratified in their entirety; (2) that the Corporation accepts the subscription of [SUBSCRIBER NAME] for the initial authorized shares, fully paid in cash or lawful consideration, and the Secretary is directed to enter the subscription in the share ledger; (3) that the registered office of the Corporation shall be the office of [REGISTERED AGENT NAME], Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that agent is confirmed as the Corporation's registered agent; and (4) that [OFFICER NAMES] are hereby appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer, with full authority to execute banking, commercial, and corporate-governance documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage a Licensed Registered Agent, Verify Name Availability, and Reserve Entity Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (actioned through an RMI-licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the RMI-licensed registered agent to conduct a name search against the Corporations Register, submit a name reservation request in the prescribed form, and confirm the proposed corporate suffix; reserve the name for the statutory period and obtain the reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Registered agent engagement letter and UBO/KYB declaration
Identity documents of incorporator and initial shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as indistinguishable or misleading, file an alternative name reservation with a distinctive corporate suffix; the Registrar will apply any paid reservation fee to the substitute reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Execute the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance (paper filing or agent-facilitated electronic lodgment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Certificate of Incorporation in the Registrar's approved form, stating the corporation's name, registered agent, registered office address in Majuro, authorized share capital (par value or no-par), and any restrictions on powers; the incorporator executes the certificate with notarization of signature, and the agent reviews for BCA compliance.
required_dossiers: Registered agent's written acceptance of agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar issues a query for deficient or inconsistent clauses, submit an amended certificate within 10 business days; the original filing date is preserved if the correction is made within the query period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Certificate of Incorporation and Settle Government Filing Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporations Registry, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Certificate of Incorporation with the Corporations Registry and pay the prescribed filing fee of USD 150.00 plus any applicable expediting fee, obtaining an official fee receipt; the Registrar issues the sealed Certificate of Incorporation once the filing is accepted and stamped.
required_dossiers: Fee remittance advice if paid by bank wire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected due to incomplete fee payment or missing signatures, cure within 5 business days by providing the notarized signature and the fee balance; use the fast-track service to preserve the intended incorporation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Collect Certificate of Incorporation, Certified Copies, and Registered Office Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (issuance counter) and the registered agent (registered office confirmation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the sealed Certificate of Incorporation and order certified copies and a Certificate of Good Standing; obtain from the registered agent a formal registered office confirmation letter and prepare the company seal requisition for internal corporate records.
required_dossiers: Identity document of person collecting on behalf of the corporation
Request letter for certified copies and Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical discrepancies such as name spelling or share capital, apply to the Registrar for a certificate of correction under the BCA correction procedure; no re-filing fee applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt Bylaws, Hold the First Board Meeting, and Appoint Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (internal corporate governance; no filing with the Registrar is required by the BCA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or obtain unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting; adopt the Bylaws; pass the pro-forma First Board Resolution accepting the share subscription, designating the registered office, and appointing the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; issue the share certificates and open the statutory corporate books.
required_dossiers: Minutes or unanimous written consent of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If corporate action is taken before officers are formally appointed, the Board may adopt a retroactive ratifying resolution and the correction shall be recorded in the minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm Non-Resident Status, Pay Government Maintenance Fee, and Obtain Tax-Exempt Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (annual government fee); Ministry of Finance, Revenue Division (tax-exempt status confirmation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the non-resident domestic corporation status declaration confirming that the corporation will not conduct business within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; pay the annual government maintenance fee; request a Certificate of Good Standing and, where required by counterparties, the tax exemption confirmation letter evidencing that the non-resident corporation is outside the RMI income tax net.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Good Standing request form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the maintenance fee is underpaid, the corporation is subject to a late penalty per the Registrar's fee schedule; settle the shortage and penalty and obtain reinstatement before any apostille or bank account opening.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment Business License Unit, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Republic of the Marshall Islands (constituted under the Foreign Investment Business License Act 2004); not applicable to a non-resident domestic corporation engaged solely in offshore trading.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Standard Business License under the Business License Act — not required for non-resident offshore trading. If a physical distribution warehouse or repackaging site in RMI were added, a Standard Business License and a Foreign Investment Business License certificate would be prerequisites.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category III (pure wholesale export trading of dehydrated vegetables and spices creates no material environmental footprint); a Full EIA Report would be triggered only upon construction of a dehydration, processing, or cold-store facility in RMI territory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at formation stage; if an RMI-based facility is later used, compliance thresholds align with RMIEPA water-quality criteria (effluent BOD not exceeding 50 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, pH 6.0–9.0), ambient air limits for particulate matter and volatile organic compounds as adopted under the RMI Clean Air Act, and the EPA waste-management standard for food-processing solid waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office-only back-to-back trading requires no civil-defense permit; if a bonded warehouse or repackaging site is introduced, the Corporation must obtain a fire-safety certificate from the Fire Marshal (Ministry of Justice), a structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works engineering division, and an occupational safety clearance under the Marshall Islands Occupational Safety and Health regulations before taking physical possession.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Treasury and Customs — Revenue and Taxation Division, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; corporate registration is administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations exclusively through licensed registered agents (online registry portal: https://register-iri.com).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations are exempt from RMI taxation and are not issued a TIN. Procedure: (1) appoint a licensed RMI registered agent; (2) file Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act (27 MIRC) or the Non-Resident Business Corporations Act, including the non-resident designation; (3) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the corporate registration number, which serves as the statutory entity identifier; (4) if goods are physically exported or transshipped through RMI ports, obtain a Customs Importer/Exporter Registration from the Customs Division; (5) if any RMI-source business is nonetheless conducted, register for the Business License and Wage and Salary Withholding with the Revenue and Taxation Division. No VAT registration exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No local check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists. Non-resident tax-exempt status is achieved through a declaratory statement in the Articles of Incorporation and the factual abstention from RMI-source business. The RMI maintains no anti-hybrid regime and no double tax treaty network. For U.S. federal purposes the entity may independently file IRS Form 8832; the RMI imposes no countervailing entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT/GST/sales tax. Indirect taxation is limited to customs import tariffs under the RMI Tariff Act and, for domestic operators, the 3% gross receipts business tax. Exports are entirely outside the indirect tax base.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT registration threshold. Any exporter moving goods through RMI customs must hold a Customs Business Registration without reference to turnover; the 3% gross receipts business tax applies only to RMI-domestic operations and has no de minimis threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate exists. Customs declarations are accepted in paper form through the Customs Division, Majuro; no ASYCUDA or electronic single-window system is operational for general cargo.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The RMI levies no VAT/GST, so no zero-rating mechanism, input VAT credit, or export refund system exists. Dehydrated vegetables and spices exported from or transshipped through the RMI are outside the indirect tax base; no export duty applies to agricultural or spice products. The RMI uses the U.S. dollar as legal tender, imposes no exchange controls, and prescribes no statutory FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark is a documentary credit and pipeline covenant.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Certificate of Origin (for GSP or bilateral preference claims at destination port)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback applies because no VAT exists. Under the RMI Customs Act, false or fraudulent export declarations attract monetary fines up to three times the value of duty or goods evaded, possible confiscation of cargo, and director/officer liability. If an audit determines that the non-resident corporation conducted RMI-source business, the tax exemption is revoked retroactively, exposing the entity to the 3% gross receipts business tax, 12% wage withholding, and business license fees for the open assessment period (typically three years), plus civil penalties and docketed tax liens.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — prudential regulator of licensed banks under the Banking Act 2012. The RMI has no domestic central bank or foreign-exchange administration; the U.S. dollar is sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association, so U.S. monetary policy (Federal Reserve System) and U.S.-dollar clearing constitute the de facto monetary framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current- and capital-account convertibility in a dollarized economy: there is no domestic currency, so no conversion obligation, no central-bank approval, and no registration applies to trade receipts, profit remittance, dividends, loan repayments, or capital repatriation. Remittance hurdles are limited to bank-level compliance: OFAC sanctions screening, FATF-related counterparty due diligence, and source-of-funds evidence. The Non-Resident Business Corporation's tax-exempt zone status removes RMI gross-revenue taxation of foreign-source dehydrated-spice export income, leaving profit remittance fully clear of exchange-control or fiscal impediments.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The RMI imposes no statutory repatriation timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender requirement for export proceeds in dehydrated vegetables and spices; receipts may remain offshore or be held in USD accounts in the RMI. Only standard bank-side CTR/STR transaction-monitoring thresholds apply; no exchange-control reporting is required.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account (corporate checking, trade settlement) and separate Capital Escrow Account for equity injection

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam (U.S.-chartered regional bank, Pacific network)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Treasury/Collection Account (secondary concentration overlay)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Registrar of Corporations annual confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands; submitted through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; first annual report due within 30 days after filing the Articles of Incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file and pay by the due date results in loss of good standing, accrued late-payment penalties, and possible administrative dissolution or strike-off by the Registrar after formal notice and failure to cure; reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding fees, penalties, and restoration charges

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory independent audit is required for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. A compulsory audit may arise only if the entity is separately licensed in a regulated sector such as banking, insurance, or investment, or if a lender, director resolution, or court order imposes audit requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: RMI does not prescribe a domestic statutory GAAP; financial records and statements are prepared in accordance with IFRS, or with US GAAP if consistently adopted by the board. Financial statements are not publicly filed with the Registrar for a non-resident Business Corporation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A beneficial ownership register must be maintained at the registered office. Within 15 days of any share transfer resulting in a change of beneficial ownership, the directors must update the register and provide updated particulars to the registered agent. The registered agent is required to conduct an annual customer due diligence refresh or UBO confirmation; RMI does not operate a public UBO registry and no public annual UBO filing is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $900 - $1,800 per annum for a standard non-resident Business Corporation; actual range depends on the registered agent and level of corporate secretarial services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $5,000 - $10,000 if a voluntary or third-party audit is commissioned; no mandatory audit fee applies to this tax-exempt non-resident trading entity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) imposed on gross revenue derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands for non-resident business corporations; 0% effective rate on all foreign-source trading income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident Business Corporations (BC) are taxed only on income sourced within the Republic. Export sales of bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper delivered, invoiced, and settled outside the RMI are foreign-source income and fully exempt. No capital gains tax, no value-added tax, no estate tax, and no withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties paid to non-residents. Preferential annual franchise tax of USD 200–300 under the Business Corporations Act replaces any income tax burden for offshore-only activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form RMI-1 (Corporate Income Tax and Gross Revenue Tax Return), filed with the RMI Division of Revenue, Ministry of Finance; electronic filing via the RMI Tax Online Portal (paper filing accepted at the Majuro Revenue Office for non-resident filers).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the last day of the fourth month following the fiscal year-end (30 April for a 31 December year-end); a 60-day extension may be granted upon written application to the Commissioner of Revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RMI Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) / Business Registration Number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the RMI Business Corporations Act registration number and the RMI TIN issued by the Registrar; non-resident BCs with no RMI-source activity must still obtain a TIN if a nil return is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter USD 0 where all sales of dehydrated vegetables and spices are made to foreign buyers, with goods shipped from origin ports outside the RMI and payments received via SWIFT LC or TT wire into foreign bank accounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source gross revenue (exempt from RMI gross revenue tax).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the full invoice value of export sales; attach a schedule listing buyer, LC/remittance reference, port of shipment, and destination. This amount is excluded from taxable gross revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exemptions and deductions (e.g., international trading exemption, shipping/trading source rules).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim the foreign-source income exemption under the RMI Income Tax Act 1989; do not claim any RMI expenses as deductions because the GRT is a gross-basis tax with no deductions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable gross revenue and computed tax at 3%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Taxable amount equals Box 2 minus Box 4; for a pure offshore trading BC this is zero, and resultant tax is USD 0. Provide a computation note even when the result is nil.

Must be signed by a director or authorised officer (not merely the registered agent); wilful false declaration triggers personal criminal liability. A nil return is recommended annually to evidence compliance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: penalty of 10% of the tax due, plus 1% for each month of continued default, capped at 25% of the tax due; late payment: 1% interest per month. Wilful failure to file or filing a false return attracts fines up to USD 25,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years under the RMI Income Tax Act 1989. Directors and officers who signed or approved the return may be assessed personally for penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and no general DTA relief mechanism for dividends. Because the statutory dividend withholding tax rate is 0%, no treaty relief is required. Where a counterparty jurisdiction asserts a withholding claim, the paying entity must obtain a Certificate of Residence (TRC) from the RMI Division of Revenue, file a claim with the paying agent, and retain the TRC plus a legal opinion confirming the RMI-source tax treatment within the transfer pricing and corporate records.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI withholding tax on cross-border royalties for intellectual property and on debt interest paid to non-residents is 0%. No treaty rate reductions are applicable; the 0% statutory rate applies directly to licence fees and intercompany loan interest paid by an RMI BC to foreign affiliates.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory RMI transfer pricing documentation law exists. Prudent non-resident compliance benchmark: prepare Local File and Master File documentation where annual related-party gross turnover exceeds USD 1,000,000 or where related-party payments for goods, royalties, or interest exceed USD 500,000 per fiscal year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations for business corporations, but the jurisdiction remains subject to OECD and Asia-Pacific Group transparency standards. A non-resident BC must maintain a registered agent and registered office in the RMI, keep a board of directors that makes decisions offshore, and avoid any management, control, or physical activity inside the RMI. Conducting board meetings or personnel activities in Majuro or Ebeye may create RMI-source income and trigger the 3% GRT; cost-plus resale margins on related-party dehydrated spice trades must be supported by arm's-length benchmarking.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Wilful Failure to File
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting RMI-source revenue from the Form RMI-1 return, filing a false nil return while conducting on-island trade, or directing export proceeds into undeclared personal accounts to avoid gross revenue tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of unpaid GRT plus a fraud penalty of 25% and monthly interest of 1%; criminal fines up to USD 25,000; imprisonment up to 3 years; cancellation of the BC's registration by the Registrar of Corporations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or cause a false return are personally liable for civil restitution of the evaded tax and penalties; courts may impose travel bans and exit control orders; the corporate veil is pierced where the corporation is a mere instrumentality of the director, exposing personal assets to seizure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the dehydrated garlic and chili export business with no books, no board resolutions, no foreign bank account, and no genuine commercial activity; using the RMI BC purely as a nominee facade to mask the true beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and dissolution under the Business Corporations Act; revocation of the registered agent appointment; fines for carrying on business under a false declaration; inclusion in international harmful tax regime listings with consequential correspondent banking restrictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for misrepresentation to the Registrar; civil restitution of foreign-asset transfers made through the shell; criminal prosecution for false statements; personal travel bans and freezing of personal assets where the entity is found to be a sham.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a register of shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners; accepting cash or untraceable payments for bulk spice shipments; dealing with sanctioned buyers or using unlicensed money remitters to settle SWIFT LC / TT wire receivables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT administrative fines up to USD 100,000; freezing orders against bank accounts; suspension of the BC's registration; criminal prosecution under the RMI Criminal Code for money laundering carrying imprisonment up to 10 years; confiscation of proceeds of crime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal criminal liability for wilful AML breaches; personal asset forfeiture; disqualification from managing any RMI entity; international arrest warrants and travel bans issued through bilateral cooperation channels.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Trade-Based Money Laundering and Invoice Manipulation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Over-invoicing or under-invoicing cross-border sales of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper between related companies to shift profits, repatriate funds disguised as trade payments, or generate false LC documentation for financial institutions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fraud-based penalties and criminal fines under the RMI Penal Code; transaction reversals and civil forfeiture; exclusion from future LC issuance; referral to financial intelligence units and foreign tax authorities; extradition-eligible money laundering charges with imprisonment up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who structure fraudulent trade documentation are personally liable for civil restitution to injured counterparties and banks; personal fines equal to the laundered amount; seizure of personal and corporate property; travel bans pending extradition where cross-border proceeds are traced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing / Documentation Default and Misreporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare contemporaneous arm's-length benchmarking for related-party purchases of dehydrated spices; setting resale margins below market without evidence; submitting tax filings inconsistent with underlying trade contracts, bank records, and shipping documents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: While the RMI has no dedicated TP penalty law, misreporting triggers the Income Tax Act's general anti-avoidance provisions: reassessment of omitted gross revenue, a 25% penalty, 1% monthly interest, and fines up to USD 25,000; documentary inconsistencies may also constitute an offence of false declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors must demonstrate good-faith diligent preparation of documentation; default exposes them to personal liability for the corporation's tax penalties in the event of insolvency; deliberate inconsistency attracts criminal liability, civil restitution, and travel bans under fraud statutes.
